questions.q: What does VIO give you that optical flow does not?
questions.explain: Flow gives velocity; VIO gives a pose; SLAM adds a map.

questions.q: Where does monocular VIO get its scale from?
questions.explain: A mono camera without an IMU does not know scale.

options: Camera frames that are too frequent
questions.explain: Lack of texture, bad light, fast rotation, bad calibration and camera–IMU desynchronization: 5 ms means noticeable drift.

questions.q: Which EK3_SRC1_POSXY value enables external navigation?
Which parameter sets the external source latency in ArduPilot?
questions.explain: The EKF accounts for the age of the measurement.

questions.q: What should the companion do when VIO tracking is lost?
questions.explain: A “frozen” pose is the worst option.

questions.q: How do you test ExternalNav before going to the field?
options: On the bench, moving it by hand
SITL: pose from truth with noise
questions.explain: Then source failure and the backup set.

questions.q: Why does VIO work poorly over a uniform surface (water, snow)?
options: It has no stable points to track
The GPS receiver interferes with the camera over water
questions.explain: Visual odometry needs textured feature points; a uniform surface doesn't provide them.
